model.claimBoundary: Authentic trained-model engineering graph only. This artifact does not establish a matching zero checkpoint, architecture equality, or a training-effect metric.

publicLayout.nodeRepresentation: One anonymous rendered point per authentic ONNX operator, counted by exact topological depth and renderer block.
publicLayout.edgeRepresentation: Only aggregate cross-block and internal tensor-edge counts are published; exact node-to-node wiring is withheld.

trainableParameterCount.basis: ONNX initializers do not encode trainability.

initializers.claimBoundary: Initializer names, hashes, shapes, and values are withheld from this public projection.

canonicalStructure.serialization: canonical compact JSON UTF-8 with sorted object keys; initializer payloads excluded

convention.elementwise: one operation per output element unless otherwise stated
convention.nonlinear: reported as evaluations unless backend kernel cost is explicitly modeled
convention.dynamicDimensions: remain symbolic in batch B; sequence length is fixed by input shape at 128
convention.moe: active compute requires authentic routing/top-k execution semantics and is not inferred from 3D layout
